description: issue #691: the melody list is pitch/duration pairs, so "The list length MUST be even" (spec/interaction-events.md:385-387); an odd-length list raises `ol-range` (the `play` entry lists `ol-range`) with params {operation:"play", value, length} (spec/error-model.md:100 requires operation + value). No `sound` event is emitted. The instruction event is still emitted before the diagnostic halts the statement.
